iconicAnchor.label: Chromolithographed trade cards and die-cut scraps
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: Mass-produced cards, labels, scraps, and catalog material establish the dense mix of type, illustration, decorative border, shaped paper, and handling wear central to Victorian ephemera.

sources.title: Horticultural artifacts collection
supports: Seed packets, trade catalogs, labels, and advertising pieces preserve commercial print hierarchies, botanical illustration, ornament, and paper formats used in period ephemera.

sources.title: Commercial print ephemera collection guide
supports: Archival collection description grounds ephemera as varied, purpose-built printed artifacts rather than a contemporary digital collage effect.

bundledReferenceRationale: Excellent single-image set. The lead clearly teaches ornate, victorian era, collage, dense, retains its identity at card scale, and shows no visible anti-cue, integrity failure, or confusing overlap with neighboring styles. The independently approved lead is assets/refs/victorian-ephemera/reference-01.jpg. No support image is needed because the lead carries the direction without filler.
